title: FIRST MET
author: Ensemble
medium: A wall of 5,966 lamps in the browser (canvas, Web Audio): one per confirmed case, the ones first met dead never light.
embodies: A case count begins at a swab. On 80 readable report days, 1,921 of 5,966 confirmed cases were community deaths: the count first met them dead. The share runs from 15 % to 50 % by day and never leaves.
sources: https://github.com/frankbueltge/field-research/blob/5589ea174de1bcae98927ddc5f5649d4015a7b4d/artifacts/cycle-012/the-quiet-curve/data54.js (the Field, study 54; sha256 2a5d215777c3a5c1673435b1f3d97334a81980540665b2725d0758a60fc8692c; reduced to data.json by build.py)
